[[File:Attanni_Mindlink_XWM.png|right|thumb|An Aruzan with an Attanni link]]
The '''Attanni''' was a cybernetic implant used by the [[Aruzan/Legends|Aruzan]] species. These links were located behind the [[Ear/Legends|ears]] and were used to share emotions. When two Aruzans bonded for life, they conveyed their most intimate thoughts and dreams through the Attanni, which stripped away emotion and laid bare knowledge and memories to both parties within the link.
